invariants.rule: Every species-origin executable grant identifies a canonical shared-owner record_ref; a species-local label cannot substitute for mechanic identity.
Every executable grant records source_ref and provenance_ref explaining the authorized species binding.
Species grant declarations and natural-equipment declarations never copy formulas, rolls, costs, durations, resource logic, conditions, effects, stacking or item mechanics owned elsewhere.
Species prerequisites, Species Perk/Innate labels, biological-looking names, dataset placement, appearance and morphology do not themselves create executable mechanics.

Natural weapons, armor and organs bind morphology to Ability/Action/Effect/Condition/Resource/Modifier and optionally ItemDefinition/Equipment references rather than creating bespoke species mechanics.
Intrinsic anatomy does not create an Asset Instance, inventory ownership, custody or equipment assignment by default; independently tracked objects route to Item/Equipment owners.
If source canon names or depicts a biological feature but supplies no authorized executable mechanic, no mechanic is fabricated.
Movement/sense and physiology/environment grants remain MVPS-04/05; equipment/interface compatibility remains MVPS-07; forms, progression and runtime projection/receipts remain MVPS-09/10/13.
Duplicate, stacking, suppression and replacement behavior is resolved by the owning shared mechanic/rules profile, not by species-local code.
